Labels, name and value
Delivery options · Choose delivery · Express (selected) · Normal · name = value · Submit delivery=express
Read the diagram step by step

Clicking an associated label selects its radio button. Both radio controls share the name
delivery, so only the selected value is submitted. The server receives delivery=express.
label එකෙ click කෙළාම input එකෙ select Jවනවා. Radio Jදෙකෙටම name එකෙ delivery නිසා එකෙකේ J+තෝරන්න පුළුවන්. Server එකෙට delivery=express යෙනවා.
